posts.title: The Blessings That Don’t Make the List
posts.description: For months, a Brooklyn barista sent me off with the same four words. On a morning when I was dreading work, I finally heard what she’d been offering me all along. That moment made me think about the small kindnesses we get used to and the ones we pass along without knowing who might need them.
